text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Air Groove's debut finally
arrives. Thanks to the strong
reputation
she's already earned, she's the clear
favorite to win this
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The frontmost runners are entering the
homestretch! And today's
favorite, Air
Groove, makes a bid for the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Can she make it? Will she do it? The finish
line is within reach! Will
Air Groove take
the win?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's all over! The Empress Air Groove
fails to clinch first by a
neck's length!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite a fine showing from the Empress,
an even fiercer opponent
seizes the
victory, leaving her to settle for second
place.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Defeat... Ugh. What a pathetic
performance!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't let my emotions get the best of
me here. My capabilities as
an empress are
simply lacking, thus leading to this failure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd best learn from this disgrace—refine
myself until I become worthy
of my name.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. I'm enacting some changes as
your client. I know we were
supposed to
have the afternoon off, but we'll be
holding a meeting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We need to completely redesign the
regimen in order to get superior
results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to submit to the bitterness of
defeat, Air Groove makes a
firm
declaration of intent, determined to
maintain her own regal
identity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I want to support her in
those lofty ambitions somehow.
If I can
convince her to make a few adjustments to
her busy
schedule...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you listening to me? You seem to
be off in your own world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You'd better not be thinking of saying
anything out of line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We established this from the start, correct? You'll be concerned only with providing me the most effective training regimen possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Or will you breach the terms of our
contract, like the others?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I truly am concerned with how busy she
finds herself on the daily. But
if I'm not
careful, then this relationship will quickly
fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I am truly at a loss as I
desperately try to think of what
best to
do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But if she attempts to keep up with
student council activities and
tutoring, it
will hinder her own growth. So please!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has joined the student council
with clear intention and
purpose. No one
can have her abdicate the role but herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize that I have yet to ask her just why
she dedicates so much
time to her
extracurricular activities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If only I could discover a little bit more
behind what makes her tick...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand the situation. So that's why
you've come to me. Mhmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I could probably tell most
anything you would want to know.
But that
would hardly qualify as grasping her true
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you really wish to be of one mind, don't
you think it would be
better to have her
reveal these things to you herself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can see that you thought long
and hard on her situation
before coming to
me. Your sincere devotion is very clear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In deference to that devotion, perhaps I
can offer some guidance.
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Symboli Rudolf to the training
grounds. There, we find Air
Groove
assisting Mejiro Dober with a training
session.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You could work on improving your starting
acceleration. Pitch your
heels immediately
and try to lead with a longer stride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A longer stride? I've tried stretching my
legs farther, but it always
makes me lose
precious speed...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Long strides require you to master a
certain rhythm—one that your
body isn't
used to yet. I think I can teach you
something helpful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Try marking the course at
one-and-a-half-meter intervals and aim to

hit those marks as accurately as possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once you get used to that distance, try
upping it to 1.8 meters, and
then up to
two. This exercise should help you hit that
rhythm you
need.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! Thank you for sharing that. I'll
give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has a bit of a complicated
relationship with men, and as
a result has a
hard time internalizing tips from the male
instructors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was the first to notice this, and
took the initiative to lend
her a helping
hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Her instruction is one of the biggest
factors behind Mejiro Dober's
success here
at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And it's not just Dober...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Suzuka. What are you
doing?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... Nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I heard that the course I wanted to run
today is closed for
maintenance, so I don't
actually have anything to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
With running off the table, nothing else
came to mind? Heh... how
very like you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, I come with some good news. The
student council just finished
looking into
that maintenance. Part of the course is now
available for
use.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh! Really?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for curfew, but knowing
you, I reckon you'd go for it
even if it
meant only getting in a few minutes of
running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're right! Thank you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka can be a bit eccentric at
times, but Air Groove has a
good
understanding of her personality. They
speak quite frequently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And in her role as vice president of the
student council, too, she
always does
everything in her power to address this
academy's issues.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The entire student body feels the benefits
of her efforts, and of
course, I couldn't ask
for a more reliable vice president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, how was that? Do you think you were
able to glean some of the
information you
were seeking?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very good. It's wise to avoid jumping to
any premature conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was a little concerned that she might cast
her scepter aside entirely,
but I'm glad to
see my fears were unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. ...She has a maiden race
coming up soon, yes? I wish you
both the
best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the student council office with
renewed resolve, ready to
consider how I
can truly help Air Groove to realize her
goals.
